Keep the highest business layer comprehensible

Management services combine coordination capabilities into broad business operations. Their diagnostics limit dependency growth and make the layer explicit in naming, preventing the top of the architecture from becoming an unstructured service locator.

The value of enforcing this family

Large processes remain navigable because even their highest-level composition has a recognisable shape.

Choose a diagnostic below for its Standard references, architectural rationale and practical bad and good code examples.
